kind: Forward public market-data acquisition pilot; no financial simulation or strategy selection
authorization: User requested continuation of the recommended native-book feasibility -> liquidation/protection -> cost-conditioned-entry sequence. No inference or order authorization.
start_gate: Signed declaration, passing exact-head CI and8 offline native-protocol tests before the one-shot recorder starts.
start_selection: First successful connection after the signed-freeze CI gate, not chosen using subsequent market returns. No alternate date or automatic restart.
environment: Existing KAIROS U.S. live public endpoint; no account login
dependency_policy: Existing locked aiohttp and Python standard library only. Recorder is private research tooling, not application/production code.
stop_conditions: 24 hours elapsed or512000000 serialized capture bytes, whichever is first; reaching the byte bound means incomplete-duration acquisition, not a full pilot.

Stop at first connection/protocol/identity/schema/sequence gap or reset, source timestamp regression, unexpected snapshot, storage or cleanup failure. Preserve saved native messages, including the failing message; do not reconnect or repair a stream.
No login, VIP/user endpoint, regional/provider fallback, account fees query, order endpoint or paid data.
data_quality_before_financial_work: Both public channels acknowledged; initial full snapshot; continuous book prevSeqId/seqId chains for the recorded connection; full offline reconstruction and level/order validation.

Complete24-hour bound without early stop, gaps, unexplained timestamp regression or missing output chunks. Zero checksum is unavailable, not a successful CRC. Any nonzero checksum needs offline validation.
Raw source timestamps, client UTC receipts and monotonic receipts retained. No assumption that receipt-minus-source time is calibrated wire latency.
Public trades can aggregate executions and do not establish individual queue priority, historical order arrival/fill probability, account fees or historical instrument rules.
A full dataset is prerequisite evidence, not return validation. Freeze the execution-only short pilot separately before calculating its financial outcomes; all original studies remain unchanged.

unchanged_financial_constraints.planned_stop_risk: <=1% of min(initial,equity), costs/dust reserved; not a guaranteed realized cap
unchanged_financial_constraints.ownership: Actual acquired base after received-currency fees only; no shorts, leverage, halt reset or fictional inventory
unchanged_financial_constraints.protection: Existing bot-managed cash IOC only. Native/algo lifecycle investigation is specification-only; KAIROS write allowlist remains unchanged.

success_claim: None; recording is not a strategy experiment or evidence of an economic edge.
